# Run HiCimpute


```{r}
o.hicimpute.muS_list = lapply(sim_y_list, function(sim_y){
  sim_y_hicimpute = sim_y %>% apply(.,2, function(y){
    mat_2d = matrix_long_to_matrix2D(y)
    return(mat_2d[upper.tri(mat_2d, diag=F)])
  } )
  
  
  Sys.time() %>% print()
  set.seed(123456)
  o.hicimpute = MCMCImpute(scHiC=sim_y_hicimpute, bulk = apply(sim_y_hicimpute, 1, sum), expected = NULL,
          startval=c(10,1,10,1,10,0.5,10,0.5,0,replicate(length(sim_y_hicimpute),1)),n=667,
          mc.cores = 1,cutoff=0.5, niter=1000,burnin=500)
  Sys.time() %>% print()
  
  o.hicimpute.muS = o.hicimpute$Impute_SZ %>% apply(2, function(x){
    mat_2D = matrix_long_to_matrix2D_offdiag(x, triangle = "upper")
    return(matrix2D_to_matrix_long(mat_2D, include.diag = F))
  })
  return(o.hicimpute.muS) 
})

```

# Run HiCluster

```{r}
# ==== INPUTS ====
# Put your seven coverage values here IN THE SAME ORDER as sim_y_list:
coverage_levels <- lambda_list

stopifnot(length(coverage_levels) == length(sim_y_list))

base_dir <- "../Input_hicluster"
prefix   <- "NPC250k_0h_X_full"   # folder name prefix
chrom_tag <- "X"                  # you’re running chrX
message("Writing contact_pair files...")

for (i in seq_along(sim_y_list)) {
  cov_str <- coverage_levels[i]
  sim_y   <- sim_y_list[[i]]          # [N_pairs x K]
  K       <- ncol(sim_y)

  cov_dir <- file.path(base_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", cov_str))
  cp_dir  <- file.path(cov_dir, "contact_pair")
  dir.create(cp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  out_name <- paste0(prefix, "_ds_", cov_str, "_", seq_len(K))

  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    mat2d <- matrix_long_to_matrix2D(sim_y[, k])
    df <- as.data.frame(mat2d) %>%
      rownames_to_column("i") %>%
      pivot_longer(-i, names_to = "j", values_to = "count") %>%
      mutate(i = as.integer(i),
             j = as.integer(sub("^V", "", j))) %>%
      filter(count > 0, i <= j)

    out_file <- file.path(cp_dir, paste0(out_name[k], "_chr", chrom_tag, ".txt"))
    write.table(df, file = out_file, sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
  }

  message(sprintf("  %s: wrote %d files -> %s", cov_str, K, cp_dir))
}
message("All contact_pair files written.")
```

```{r}

# ===============================
# CONFIG
# ===============================
root_dir <- "../Input_hicluster"   # adjust if needed
prefix   <- "NPC250k_0h_X_full"
chrom_tag <- "X"  # you imputed chrX
out_rds  <- file.path(root_dir, paste0("scHiCluster_", prefix, "_chr", chrom_tag, "_allcov_muS.rds"))

# ===============================
# HELPERS
# ===============================

# Extract coverage string from a coverage directory path:
# .../NPC250k_0h_X_full_0.002  -> "0.002"
dir_to_cov <- function(d) sub(paste0("^.*", prefix, "_"), "", d)

# Extract numeric cell index from filename patterns like:
# "imputed_matrixNPC250k_0h_X_full_ds_0.002_10_chrX_pad1_std1_rp0.5_sqrtvc.hdf5"
get_cell_idx <- function(paths) {
  as.integer(sub(".*_ds_[^_]+_([0-9]+)_chr.*", "\\1", basename(paths)))
}

# Numeric sort by extracted cell index
num_sort_by_cell <- function(paths) {
  ord <- order(get_cell_idx(paths), na.last = TRUE)
  paths[ord]
}

# ===============================
# COLLECT
# ===============================
cov_dirs <- list.dirs(root_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
cov_dirs <- cov_dirs[grepl(paste0("/", prefix, "_"), cov_dirs)]  # keep only coverage dirs

if (!length(cov_dirs)) stop("No coverage directories found under: ", root_dir)

muS_sc_NPC <- setNames(vector("list", length(cov_dirs)), nm = vapply(cov_dirs, dir_to_cov, character(1)))

for (d in cov_dirs) {
  cov_str <- dir_to_cov(d)                                # e.g. "0.002"
  imp_dir <- file.path(d, "imputed_matrix")
  if (!dir.exists(imp_dir)) {
    warning("Missing imputed_matrix dir: ", imp_dir)
    next
  }

  h5_files <- list.files(imp_dir, pattern = "\\.hdf5$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(h5_files)) {
    warning("No .hdf5 files in: ", imp_dir)
    next
  }

  # Keep only chrX files and sort by cell index
  h5_files <- h5_files[grepl(paste0("_chr", chrom_tag), h5_files)]
  if (!length(h5_files)) {
    warning("No chr", chrom_tag, " .hdf5 files in: ", imp_dir)
    next
  }

  h5_files <- num_sort_by_cell(h5_files)

  # Read each HDF5 -> long vector
  long_list <- lapply(h5_files, process_hdf5_file, include_diag = TRUE)  # or FALSE to match your geometry
  lens <- vapply(long_list, length, integer(1))
  if (length(unique(lens)) != 1L) stop("Inconsistent long vector lengths in: ", imp_dir)

  muS_mat <- do.call(cbind, long_list)  # N_pairs × K
  colnames(muS_mat) <- paste0("cell", seq_along(long_list))
  muS_sc_NPC[[cov_str]] <- muS_mat

  message(sprintf("Assembled %s | coverage=%s | [%d x %d]",
                  basename(d), cov_str, nrow(muS_mat), ncol(muS_mat)))
}

# Drop NULLs if any coverage had no files
muS_sc_NPC <- muS_sc_NPC[!vapply(muS_sc_NPC, is.null, logical(1))]


```

## SCC

```{r, fig.width=12}
list_muS = list_muS_combine
scc_vector = lapply(list_muS, function(muS){
  muS[is.na(muS)] = 0
  sapply(1:K, function(k) evaluate_mu(true_muS[,k], muS[,k], smooth = 0))[5,]
}) %>% unlist()
scc_vector[is.na(scc_vector)] = 0
scc_muS = data.frame(
  cell = rep(1:K, length(list_muS)),
  SCC = scc_vector,
  label = rep(names(list_muS), each = K) %>% 
    # factor(,levels = c("Raw", "BHZIP-mixed","HiCImpute","HiCluster"))
    factor(,levels = names(list_muS))
) 
scc_muS <- scc_muS %>%
  mutate(
    method = gsub(",ld=.*", "", label),  # Remove the ds part to isolate the method
    ld = gsub(".*ld=", "", label),  # Isolate the ds part
    ld = as.numeric(ld)  # Convert ds to numeric
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = names(list_muS)),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("Raw", "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)","HiCBZIP-N(M)", "scHiCluster", "HiCImpute")),
    ld = factor(ld, levels = lambda_list)
  )

ggplot(scc_muS, aes(x = ld, y = SCC, group = label, fill = method, color = method)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(
       x = "Lambda",
       y = "SCC",
       title = "SCC with Truth of 30 Downsampled scHiC Matrices") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

## add sparsity

```{r}
sparsity_list = sapply(list_muS[1:7], function(sim_y) mean(sim_y==0))
names(sparsity_list) = lambda_list
sparsity_list
sparsity_labels <- sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * sparsity_list)
sparsity_labels
```

```{r}
lambda_vals = as.numeric(lambda_list)
```


### SCC

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
scc_muS <- scc_muS %>%
  mutate(ld_num = as.numeric(as.character(ld)),
    Method = recode(method, "Raw" = "Downsampled"))

# create base plot using numeric λ (continuous)
ggplot(scc_muS, aes(x = ld_num, y = SCC, fill = Method, color = Method, group = interaction(Method, ld_num))) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.size = 0.5,
    width = 0.2,  # narrower box to fix spacing
    linewidth = 0.3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = lambda_vals,
    labels = names(sparsity_list),
    sec.axis = dup_axis(
      breaks = lambda_vals,
      labels = sparsity_labels,
      name = "Sparsity"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(lambda),
    y = "SCC",
    title = "Recovery of Contact-Level Correlations Across Coverage Levels"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x.top = element_text(size = 12, vjust = -0.5),
    axis.text.x.top  = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

### IS


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
IS_vector_plot2 <- IS_vector_plot %>%
  mutate(ld_num = as.numeric(as.character(ld)),
         Method = recode(method, "Raw" = "Downsampled"))

ggplot(IS_vector_plot2,
       aes(x = ld_num, y = IS,
           fill = Method, color = Method,
           group = interaction(Method, ld_num))) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.size = 0.5,
    width = 0.2,  # narrower box to fix spacing
    linewidth = 0.3,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(lambda),
    y = "Pearson Correlation",
    title = "Recovery of Insulation Scores Across Coverage Levels"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = lambda_vals,
    labels = names(sparsity_list),
    sec.axis = dup_axis(
      breaks = lambda_vals,
      labels = sparsity_labels,
      name = "Sparsity"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x.top = element_text(size = 12, vjust = -0.5),

    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
